articles.title: CP Group Sells Third Boca Raton Office for $79M
articles.narrative: CP Group and Harrison Street Asset Management have sold One Boca Place, a 286,890-square-foot office complex in Boca Raton, FL, for $78.9 million to Golden East Investors. The transaction was financed by City National Bank of Florida with an $82.1 million loan. This sale represents the third office property CP Group has divested in Boca Raton since the summer, following the sales of Two Town Center and the BRiC campus.

data_points.notable_features: Two-building office property located just west of Interstate 95, near the Town Center at Boca Raton indoor mall.
data_points.project_notes: Sellers acquired the complex for $76.4 million in 2014.

articles.title: New York City’s Pied-à-Terre Surcharge Changes the Investment Calculation
articles.narrative: A new pied-à-terre surcharge in New York City is significantly altering investment calculations for residential properties, particularly luxury apartments, co-ops, and condos. The surcharge, ranging from 4% to 6.5% of the Department of Finance valuation for the 2026-27 and 2027-28 tax years, applies to second homes and can also impact co-op owners if a neighbor's bill goes unpaid. While commercial office, retail condos, and ordinary Class 2 rental buildings are exempt, some smaller mixed-use Class 1 buildings require individual review. The author suggests that these new costs may make alternative property types, such as rental buildings and commercial condos, more attractive to certain buyers seeking income-generating assets without the surcharge burden.

articles.title: Revamp NYC Wants to Bring 99 Units to the Financial District’s 160 Pearl Street
articles.narrative: Revamp NYC has filed an application with the New York City Department of Buildings to construct a 25-story, 99-unit residential building with ground-floor retail at 160 Pearl Street in Manhattan's Financial District. The project would add to the neighborhood's growing residential community, though it is currently unclear if the developer plans to include affordable housing units to qualify for tax incentives or if the existing commercial building will be demolished.

data_points.address: 160 Pearl Street, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Proposed amenities include indoor and outdoor recreation space and a yoga room.
data_points.project_notes: The project may qualify for New York's 485-x tax incentive for buildings with 99 or fewer units that include affordable housing.

articles.title: Rexford Sells $1.3B in SoCal Industrial Assets as Leasing Rebounds
articles.narrative: Rexford Industrial Realty, a Los Angeles-based REIT, sold 25 industrial properties totaling 5.5 million square feet for $1.3 billion in Southern California during the third quarter, including a $1.2 billion portfolio sale to EQT Real Estate. This marks a significant step in Rexford's $2 billion portfolio realignment strategy, shifting from buyer to seller. Despite rising Treasury yields impacting buyer capital costs, the company anticipates completing the remaining $500 million in planned sales by year-end. Concurrently, Rexford reported strong leasing activity, executing 116 leases covering 3.74 million square feet, leading to an increase in same-property occupancy to 96.9% and positive net effective rent spreads.

data_points.project_notes: The portfolio sale to EQT Real Estate had a weighted average remaining lease term of 2.7 years with rents nearly 30% above market rates. Rexford also sold three properties totaling 251,000 square feet to owner-users for $86 million.

articles.market_intelligence: Rexford's same-property occupancy rose to 96.9% in Q3 from 94.9% in Q2, though slightly below 97.1% a year earlier. Net effective rent spreads on new leases increased 7.1% in Q3, compared with declines of 2.8% in Q2. Leasing activity was driven most heavily by light manufacturing and advanced manufacturing (about one-third), with another third from logistics, distribution, and warehouse.

articles.title: Roof of Concept: Meet Jeff Thramann, a Data Center Disruptor
articles.narrative: This article profiles Jeff Thramann, CEO of LT350, a company he co-founded with former U.S. Secretary of Defense Mark Esper. LT350 is developing an innovative data center concept that involves installing mini data centers on the roofs of solar power canopies above parking lots at properties like malls, hospitals, and schools. This approach aims to provide low-latency inference capabilities by integrating solar panels with modular cartridges containing GPUs, battery storage, and inverters, effectively turning parking lot airspace into a data center without consuming additional land. The company is targeting healthcare, financial services, and government sectors due to their need for low latency and high data security, and plans to break ground on its first project at a Dallas hospital early next year.

data_points.notable_features: Modular data centers integrated into solar canopies above parking lots, designed for low-latency inference and data security.
data_points.project_notes: LT350 is currently involved in a merger with Auddia, an AI audio technology company, and will be owned by Thramann Holdings.

articles.title: Joint Venture Completes 873-Bed Student Housing Project in College Station
articles.narrative: A joint venture comprising The Dinerstein Cos., Up Campus Student Living, and Harrison Street Asset Management has completed Aspire Reserve, an 873-bed student housing development in College Station, TX. The 19-story property is located near the Texas A&M University campus within the Northgate District. It offers a variety of unit types and extensive amenities designed for student residents.

data_points.notable_features: Located within the Northgate District near Texas A&M University campus; amenities include two pools, study spaces, golf/gaming simulator, resident game lounges, beauty bar, retail market, and indoor/outdoor fitness center with yoga and spin studios.

articles.title: McGrath Real Estate Completes Lease-Up of 736-Bed Student Housing Project in Lubbock, Texas
articles.narrative: McGrath Real Estate has successfully completed the lease-up of The Wyatt, a 736-bed student housing community in Lubbock, TX, serving Texas Tech University students. The property achieved approximately 98 percent occupancy shortly after its 2025 completion and was fully preleased for the 2026 academic year by May. Strong leasing momentum continues, with over 30 percent of beds already preleased for the fall 2027 semester.

data_points.notable_features: Serves students at Texas Tech University.

articles.title: Joint Venture Breaks Ground on Student Housing, Retail Development Near University of Texas at San Antonio
articles.narrative: A joint venture between Barshop & Oles Co. and Phoenix Property Co. has broken ground on La Cantera Crossing, a 10-acre mixed-use development near the University of Texas at San Antonio. The project will feature a 563-bed student housing community and retail space, with Phoenix Property Co. developing the student housing and Barshop & Oles handling the retail component. The student housing is slated for completion in fall 2028.

data_points.notable_features: Located near the University of Texas at San Antonio campus.

articles.title: Virtu Signs 55,000 SF Office Lease at The Republic in Downtown Austin
articles.narrative: Virtu, a global financial services firm, has signed a 55,000-square-foot office lease at The Republic, a 48-story office tower in downtown Austin. The firm will occupy two high-rise floors in the building. The lease signifies continued demand for prime office space in the Austin market.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap closes sale of 28,860-square-foot industrial property in Lewis Center
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the sale of a 28,860-square-foot industrial property in Lewis Center, Ohio. The fully occupied, three-tenant building was sold by The Fergus Companies to a Los Angeles-based real estate investor. The property benefits from its stable tenant base and strategic business location.

data_points.address: 8377 Green Meadows Drive, Lewis Center, OH
data_points.notable_features: Three-tenant industrial property with longstanding tenant histories.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap closes sale of 729-unit self-storage portfolio in Rockport, Victoria
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the sale of the Fortress Storage Center portfolio, comprising two self-storage facilities with a combined 729 units and 85,150 rentable square feet. The properties are located in Rockport and Victoria, Texas. The portfolio offers a mix of climate-controlled and non-climate-controlled units, gated access, video surveillance, and on-site management.

data_points.notable_features: Both facilities offer climate-controlled and non-climate-controlled storage, gated access, video surveillance, and on-site management offices. The Victoria property also includes an on-site manager’s residence.

articles.title: Associated Bank completes $16.5 million loan for 34-unit apartment property in Libertyville
articles.narrative: Associated Bank has provided a $16.5 million loan for the acquisition of Eleven5 Lake Apartments, a mixed-use property in Libertyville, Illinois. The property, which sold for $22 million, features 34 apartment units and 25,147 square feet of ground-floor commercial space. The apartments were 97% occupied at the time of acquisition, while the commercial space was fully leased to five tenants.

data_points.notable_features: Includes 41 dedicated apartment parking spaces and is located a block south of the Metra Milwaukee District North line.

articles.title: Tishman Speyer, American Express Partner to Offer ZO Access to Non-Tenants
articles.narrative: Tishman Speyer has partnered with American Express to extend access to its ZO amenity network to eligible U.S. Business Platinum Card and Corporate Platinum Card holders. This collaboration marks the first time a major commercial real estate landlord has teamed up with a credit card issuer to offer such benefits to non-tenants. Cardholders will gain complimentary access to over 20 ZO Clubhouse and Studio coworking locations across six major cities, along with guest passes and annual statement credits for event space bookings.

articles.title: Skechers Headquarters in Manhattan Beach Listed for Sale
articles.narrative: The Skechers corporate headquarters, a nearly 30,000-square-foot Class A office building at 228 Manhattan Beach Blvd. in Manhattan Beach, CA, has been listed for sale. The three-story property, which was extensively renovated in 2018 and includes a 69-stall subterranean parking garage, is being offered through a competitive bidding process and will be delivered vacant. This represents a rare opportunity to acquire a high-quality, immediately occupiable office asset in a desirable coastal market.

data_points.address: 228 Manhattan Beach Blvd., Manhattan Beach, CA
data_points.notable_features: Class A building with a 69-stall private, three-level subterranean parking garage and potential for ground-floor retail.
data_points.project_notes: Property was extensively renovated in 2018 and will be delivered vacant.

articles.title: Tech Employment Training Group Signs Headquarters Lease in Long Island City
articles.narrative: Pursuit Transformation Company Inc., a non-profit focused on tech and AI employment training, has signed a long-term lease for approximately 41,000 square feet at The JACX in Long Island City. This new headquarters will occupy the entire 14th and 15th floors of the Class A office development, allowing Pursuit to expand its operations and continue its mission in a supportive environment.

data_points.address: 28-07 Jackson Ave, Long Island City, NY

articles.title: Lewis Group Opens Second NorCal Rental-Home Community in West Sacramento
articles.narrative: Lewis Apartments has opened Independence in West Sacramento, a new gated community featuring 208 townhome-style rental homes. This marks the developer's second such community in Northern California, following a successful launch in Dixon. The project aims to provide residents with the spaciousness and privacy of a single-family home, coupled with the flexibility and reduced responsibilities of renting.

data_points.notable_features: Gated community of townhome-style rental homes located in the Southport/Bridgeway Island area.

articles.title: Owner-Occupant Pays $25M for East Rutherford Industrial
articles.narrative: An owner-occupant has acquired an 86,000-square-foot industrial warehouse at 180 Manor Rd. in East Rutherford, NJ, for $25 million. The property will serve as the buyer's new headquarters, allowing for expansion while remaining in the area. The transaction highlights the challenges owner-users face in securing quality industrial properties in high-barrier-to-entry markets.

data_points.notable_features: Convenient access to Routes 17 and 3, I-80, I-280, and the New Jersey Turnpike at Exit 16W.

articles.title: Cushman & Wakefield, NYC Added To Suit Alleging $250K Agency Lease Shakedown
articles.narrative: New York City and Cushman & Wakefield have been added to a lawsuit filed by Mazen Dayem, which alleges a $250,000 shakedown related to an agency lease. The lawsuit seeks up to $52 million in damages, citing alleged bribes and breach of contract.

articles.title: 'Office Is Back' As Corporate Relocations Continue To Fuel Demand In Collin County
articles.narrative: Collin County is experiencing a surge in office demand, driven by significant corporate relocations. This trend is expected to continue, with numerous large-scale development projects poised to substantially increase the region's office inventory.

articles.title: Hudson Pacific's Historic San Francisco Conversion Project Gets Approval
articles.narrative: Hudson Pacific Properties has received approval to convert a historic 115-year-old building on Market Street in San Francisco into 136 residential units. This adaptive reuse project aims to contribute to the city's housing supply by transforming an existing structure into new residential inventory.

data_points.notable_features: Historic 115-year-old building being converted to residential.

articles.title: Hollywood's Yamashiro Complex Gets $25M Refinance: The Los Angeles Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: PSRS has secured a $25 million refinance loan for the Yamashiro complex in Hollywood, which comprises a restaurant, a hotel, and a multifamily building. This refinancing provides capital for the iconic property, ensuring its continued operation and stability.

data_points.notable_features: Includes a restaurant, hotel, and multifamily building.

articles.title: Why Sun Belt Multifamily Giant Cortland Is Moving Its Money North
articles.narrative: Cortland, a prominent multifamily investor, is shifting its investment focus from the Sun Belt to Northern markets, particularly the Washington D.C. area. CEO Steven DeFrancis indicated that the firm was attracted to a D.C.-area multifamily portfolio, signaling a strategic pivot in their acquisition strategy. This move suggests a belief in the long-term value and stability of Northern multifamily assets.
